facts.text: If you move, you must notify the DMV of your new address within ten days, online or by mail.

cites.quote: If you move, you must notify DMV of your new address within ten days. Submit a change of address online at dmv.ca.gov/addresschange or by mail.

facts.text: It is your responsibility to make sure the DMV has your correct mailing address on record.

cites.quote: It is your responsibility to ensure DMV has your correct mailing address on record.

facts.text: You do not automatically get a new driver's license when you change your address; you may request a replacement for a fee.

cites.quote: You do not automatically get a new driver’s license when you change your address. You may request a replacement for a fee.

facts.text: It is against the law to drive with an expired driver's license.

cites.quote: It is against the law to drive with an expired driver’s license.

facts.text: If you are not eligible to renew your driver's license online, you must visit a DMV office.

cites.quote: If ineligible to renew online, visit a DMV office.

facts.text: If your driver's license and identity document expire on the same date, you must provide a valid identity document before DMV can issue your license.

cites.quote: Your driver’s license and identity document may expire on the same date. If so, you will be required to provide a valid identity document.

facts.text: If you are a minor renewing or replacing a license, your parent or guardian must sign the application.

cites.quote: If you are a minor, your parent or guardian must sign the application.

facts.text: Once you receive a replacement driver's license, your old card is no longer valid; if you find it, destroy it.

cites.quote: Once you receive your replacement card, your old card is no longer valid. If you find the old card, destroy it.

facts.text: If you are out of state and cannot renew, you may request a one-year extension of your driver's license, submitted before the license expires.

cites.quote: If you are out-of-state and cannot renew, you may request a one year extension of your driver’s license.

facts.text: Limited-term driver's licenses are not eligible for the one-year out-of-state extension.

cites.quote: Limited-term driver’s licenses are not eligible for this extension.
